name: Arabesque! ~Shoujo-tachi no Orinasu Ai no Monogatari~
original_name: アラベスク ～少女たちの織りなす愛の物語～
source:
A young girl named Alice is heading home by car with her boyfriend K on a dark spring night, but K decides to stop in the middle of the forest, where they share a strange sexual experience. Afterwards, K tells Alice to head to a nearby mansion, which he says is owned by his friend. K says he will join her afterwards.

Alice finds the mansion and its inhabitants: a masked man and five girls. Why are they living here? What is their relationship with each other? Alice will have time to find out as she waits for her boyfriend to come.
translation:
一个漆黑的春夜，少女爱丽丝与男友K开车回家。K却决定在森林中央停车，两人在那里经历了一场奇异的性爱。事后，K让爱丽丝前往附近一座宅邸，并称那里属于自己的朋友；他稍后就会前去会合。

爱丽丝找到了宅邸，也见到了住在里面的人：一个戴面具的男人和五名少女。他们为什么住在这里？彼此之间又是什么关系？等待男友到来的这段时间里，爱丽丝将有机会找出答案。
